comment: Approximate public on-demand pricing in integer microusd per hour. hourly_microusd tracks e2-small; e2_medium_hourly_microusd is an approximation pinned at roughly double the e2-small rate (e2-medium has 2x the vCPU share and memory). Snapshot of cloud.google.com/compute/vm-instance-pricing; refresh this file when GCP publishes new rates or when a region is added to the catalog in src/providers/gcp.rs. Egress is a flat approximation of premium-tier internet egress.
